scenarios.title: WorkManager baseline state
requiredCommands: adb shell dumpsys activity services com.chloemlla.aura
expectedEvidence: Every unique work name from the scheduling ledger is checked against WorkManager or support-bundle output.
Foreground service state and exported automation receiver state are captured before scheduler stress tests.

scenarios.title: Metered network and Data Saver state
expectedEvidence: Diagnostics action hints match metered and restricted-background state.
Unmetered-only Aura Originals work remains deferred on metered network evidence.

scenarios.title: Low battery constraint state
requiredCommands: adb shell cmd battery set level 10
expectedEvidence: Battery-not-low constrained work is deferred while the battery level is forced low.
The device battery override is restored after capture.

scenarios.title: Doze and App Standby scheduling delay
requiredCommands: adb shell am set-standby-bucket com.chloemlla.aura restricted
expectedEvidence: Doze or restricted standby bucket state is visible in captured device state.
Delayed WorkManager jobs are reconciled with the Settings background-work diagnostics copy.

scenarios.title: Android 16 TOP-started and foreground-service-concurrent job quota
requiredCommands: adb shell am compat enable OVERRIDE_QUOTA_ENFORCEMENT_TO_TOP_STARTED_JOBS com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell am compat enable OVERRIDE_QUOTA_ENFORCEMENT_TO_FGS_JOBS com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell am set-standby-bucket com.chloemlla.aura active
adb shell dumpsys activity services com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell am compat reset OVERRIDE_QUOTA_ENFORCEMENT_TO_TOP_STARTED_JOBS com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell am compat reset OVERRIDE_QUOTA_ENFORCEMENT_TO_FGS_JOBS com.chloemlla.aura
expectedEvidence: TOP-started and foreground-service-concurrent quota enforcement overrides are active before scheduler capture and reset afterward.

rotation_trigger_oneshot is correlated with RotationTriggerService state: the trigger is enqueued with ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND_OR_REPLACE, which queues a later trigger behind rotation work that is already pending and runs the queued runs in order rather than coalescing them.
Settings and the support bundle expose any QUOTA, TIMEOUT, BACKGROUND_RESTRICTION, or constraint WorkInfo stop reason for all audited unique work names.
No direct Aura JobService, retained JobParameters, or STOP_REASON_TIMEOUT_ABANDONED failure is present.

scenarios.title: Rotation trigger append ordering and constraint deferral
requiredCommands: adb shell am broadcast -a com.chloemlla.aura.action.ROTATE_NOW -p com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell am broadcast -a com.chloemlla.aura.action.SHUFFLE_NOW -p com.chloemlla.aura
adb shell dumpsys activity services com.chloemlla.aura
expectedEvidence: Repeated public rotation broadcasts enqueue onto the single unique work name rotation_trigger_oneshot, where ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND_OR_REPLACE queues a later trigger behind rotation work that is already pending and runs the queued runs in order instead of coalescing or dropping them.

Any rotation-trigger deferral is attributed to the constraints resolved by buildAutoWallpaperConstraints(...) from the cached source-aware flags (network requirement derived from the active wallpaper source, battery-not-low, plus opt-in charging and device-idle) rather than to expedited-work quota, since the request is a plain non-expedited one-shot.
